params.body:
Makes the voice page an app the phone installs: "Werkbank" on the home screen, standalone, with no address bar.

- **`voice/app.mjs`:**
  - **The manifest:** name Werkbank, `display: standalone`, portrait, ink theme.
  - **A service worker** that keeps the page itself for when the workbench is out of reach. It fetches everything else from the network: a session, an action or a notice is never served from a cache.
  - **The icon,** drawn as a PNG by the bridge: a paper ring and dot on ink, inside the safe zone of a maskable icon, at 192 and 512 px. No image file lives in the repository.
- **`bridge.mjs`** serves `/manifest.webmanifest`, `/sw.js`, `/icon-192.png` and `/icon-512.png`, behind the same login check as the page.
- **`page.html`** links the manifest and the icon, and registers the service worker.

Checked on a test port: all four answer 200 with the right content type, and the 512 px icon is a valid PNG (looked at).

Installing needs HTTPS on the tailnet (`tailscale serve`), and the tailnet needs HTTPS certificates switched on first.
params.title: The voice page installs as an app
